Contact us

We welcome comments and enquiries about any of our activities and services. You can contact us in a number of ways.

Check our frequently asked questions to see if we can answer your query. Otherwise, take a look at who to contact below. 

If you have a query about a specific course or an ongoing application, please contact the relevant academic School directly. Use the search tool below to find the correct contact details.

For more information on enquiries or concerns about students, visit:

  • Enquiries or concerns about students

For information about visiting our campus, please visit:

  • Maps and travel 

If you are planning on attending an open day, specific information is available:

  • Open days

To view a digital prospectus please visit:

  • Undergraduate
  • International

  • International Team

For questions relating to Graduation ceremonies, Graduation videos, academic transcripts and duplicate degree certificates, visit our Graduation website or contact our Student Services Centre.

For alumni and donor-related enquiries, please contact:

  • Development and Alumni Relations

If you have a press or media enquiry for The University of Manchester, contact:

  • Media Relations Team

The University’s first priority is always the safety and security of staff, students and visitors to our campus. Our Security team is available on campus 24/7 and can provide an immediate response in the event of an emergency or incident.

To report any on-campus incidents, contact:

Security Control Room (24-hour contact number)
Tel: 0161 306 9966
